title: FeaturePlanPreparationService
responsibility: Prepare affected page designs and pass a coverage-checked feature plan draft to trusted collaborators.

inputs.name: FeaturePlanPreparationService.constructor.dependencies
inputs.description: Trusted discovery, admitted page preparation, artifact finalization, coverage verification, and draft collaborators. The finalizer must independently verify the resulting committed artifacts and metadata.

inputs.name: FeaturePlanPreparationService.prepare.input
inputs.description: Unapproved proposal, committed module metadata, and cancellation signal. The source and metadata commits must match.

outputs.name: FeaturePlanPreparationService.prepare
outputs.description: Discovers affected pages, admits parallel preparation of three distinct unselected choices with exactly one preferred option per page, waits for all admitted page work to settle, checks final metadata and coverage, then returns the trusted draft collaborator result. It does not start workers or itself verify Git lineage.

errors.name: Incomplete or cancelled preparation
errors.description: Rejects missing collaborators, inconsistent revisions, invalid discovery, malformed choices, incomplete coverage, collaborator errors, or cancellation before drafting.

cases.subject: FeaturePlanPreparationService.prepare
cases.input: Proposal with module goals and wanted contracts, shared goal/TLDR, original request, page references, edit regions, and cancellation signal.

test.title: prepare drafts only after every affected page design is committed and coverage is complete
